_comment: Configuration of config_adapter.py for one repository. Everything repository-specific lives here, never in the adapter.

distinct._comment: A value counts as copied only if it is specific: long enough, not a plain number or measure, not a single plain word (kernel vocabulary and labels). Paths in match_as_word bypass the word rules.

runtime_trace: Implemented: run the test suite with the settings engine's LX_SETTINGS_TRACE patch (intake/patches/settings-trace.patch) and pass the file with --runtime-trace. Covers the declaration read through settings.load (settings).

sources._comment: Every file here is declared above or listed with the reason it is not; any other is reported as unaccounted.
